title: Leaderboard, premium rebuild: a lit board in perspective, capsules that race, the top row glowing
goal:
Krish, 10 Nov: "these animations do not look very premium" and "the visual quality looks incredibly low effort and sub par". Seen: small devices in a flat black void, no light or depth, tiny generic type, emoji-like glyphs, frames that stand still. Bar: his Fri 23 Oct and Mon 26 Oct cuts (config/reference-cuts.json). 16:9 first: box 1920x1080, face window bottom right (1452,676,400,340) kept clear; tall second.

Every state:
a. Fill at least 80% of the box width.
b. A lit stage: inkDeep to ink radial light from upper left, soft floor shadows, SVG film grain at 3% re-seeded every 2 frames.
c. A camera: push 1.00 to 1.06 over the device's life, background parallax 0.5x, house easing from clock.ts, overshoot at most 4%.
d. Always alive: no frame repeats for more than 15 frames while on screen.
e. Type: numbers and the headline in Anton 120 px+, human words Fraunces semibold 56 px+, Plex Mono only for a source line 28 px+; at most two labels; no axis zeros or titles.

The story, in states (verbs unchanged): enter, a dark glass board rises into a gentle perspective (rotateX 8 degrees, easing flat as the camera pushes), header in Anton 120 px; add, rows slide in with a 3-frame stagger, each with a rank numeral in Anton, an initial in a cream circle and the label in Fraunces 56 px; fill, thick capsule bars race to their values with a coral gradient and a moving light sweep, the leader's row lifting 8 px with a soft coral glow; stamp keeps its meaning (a hard coral stamp with its text, slammed with a 6-frame squash). Rows re-order with a physical swap when values change. The note and the producer label draw only when set.
contract: Change only the leaderboard device and its fixture and tests; verbs and params keep their meaning. Colours only from tokens. Keep existing tests passing and add: no text under 28 px; the board spans at least 70% of a 16:9 box; an empty note draws nothing; no two consecutive identical frames for more than 15 frames between enter and exit.
acceptance:
npx vitest run apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/leaderboard
npx vitest run apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/verbs.test.ts
